# Learning Opportunities Hub Business Brief

## Context

Kitewood Learning Collective coordinates internal training for staff working
across several locations. Session information is currently prepared by
different coordinators and published through general communication channels.

The organization wants a new Learning Opportunities Hub.

## Objectives

- Give staff one place to discover available learning sessions.
- Make place requests and approvals visible.
- Reduce manual coordination for training coordinators.
- Give managers a dependable view of pending approvals.
- Provide consistent participation information for planning.

## Success Direction

The sponsor expects staff to find relevant sessions more easily and
coordinators to spend less time reconciling request lists. Baseline measures
and target values have not yet been approved.

## Governance

The people-development director sponsors the initiative. A product owner has
not been formally appointed. Training operations, department managers,
technology, accessibility, and data-protection representatives will
contribute.
